'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Myanmar protests]]
**[[Myanmar]] [[Tatmadaw|security forces]] begin violently dispersing anti-[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|coup]] protesters and clearing makeshift road blocks, killing a total of 18 protesters in several cities. More than 30 others are wounded by live rounds, and several have been arrested. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/28/one-reported-dead-many-hurt-as-myanmar-police-fire-at-protesters (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Ten civilians are killed, of whom eight have been decapitated and two shot, in two [[Allied Democratic Forces|ADF]] overnight attacks in Boyo and Kainama, [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/1/8-villagers-decapitated-by-suspected-adf-rebels-in-dr-congo-army (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Chad]]ian security forces raid the home of opposition leader [[Yaya Dillo Djérou]] in [[N'Djamena]], killing five of his relatives, including his mother and son. A [[government of Chad|government]] statement says the raid was an operation to arrest Dillo. Two other people are also killed and five others are wounded in the ensuing fight. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/28/chad-opposition-candidate-says-security-forces-raided-his-home (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
*****The [[Philippines]] receives its first shipment of 600,000 doses of the [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] donated by [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/cabinets-philippines-coronavirus-pandemic-asia-east-asia-e6f826359395951b2c805dbd90f34205 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] surpasses 60,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]], the highest death toll of a [[Middle East]]ern country. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2021/02/28/Coronavirus-Iran-health-ministry-says-virus-deaths-cross-60-000-mark (Al-Arabiya English)]
****Iran receives their first shipment of 250,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2021/02/28/2461154/iran-gets-chinese-vaccine-for-coronavirus/amp (Tasnim News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] officially lifts the COVID-19 [[state of emergency]] in [[Aichi Prefecture|Aichi]], [[Gifu Prefecture|Gifu]], [[Kyoto Prefecture|Kyoto]], [[Osaka Prefecture|Osaka]], [[Hyogo Prefecture|Hyogo]], and [[Fukuoka Prefecture|Fukuoka]] prefectures due to a decrease in the number of cases, while [[Tokyo]] and surrounding areas will remain in a state of emergency until at least March 7. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20210228_02/amp.html (NHK World)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] surpasses 300,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2021/02/669776/covid-19-2437-new-cases-nine-deaths (''New Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] begins a [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19 using the [[Sinovac]] [[CoronaVac]] vaccine. [[List of government ministries of Thailand|Government ministers]] and [[health worker]]s are among the first to receive doses of the vaccine. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-28/thailand-kicks-off-covid-19-vaccine-program-with-sinovac-shots (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom]]
*****The number of people who have received their first dose of the vaccine in the [[United Kingdom]] reaches 20 million, making it the fastest vaccination program in Europe. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/covid-vaccine-first-dose-uk-jab-b1808757.html (''The Independent'')]
****[[Lineage P.1]]
*****The United Kingdom reports their first cases of the Lineage P.1 variant first detected in [[Manaus]], [[Brazil]] in three people from [[England]] and three people from [[Scotland]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-56233038 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] receives the first dose of the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/hungary-pm-orban-receives-chinese-virus-jab-01614514804 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia]]
*****[[Australia]] receives their first shipment of 300,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[vaccine]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-02-28/astrazeneca-oxford-vaccine-doses-arrive-in-australia/13201032 (ABC Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****[[Auckland]] enters alert level 3 [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for seven days, with the rest of the [[New Zealand|country]] entering alert level 2. This comes after a new COVID-19 case of unknown origin was detected. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/covid-19-coronavirus-auckland-in-alert-level-3-lockdown-for-a-week-rest-of-nz-at-level-2-jacinda-ardern/OWBIIXGYZQIPJL36WZYZKSEWH4/ (''NZ Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[President of South Africa|President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] announces that [[South Africa]]'s alert level will be lowered to level one effective midnight following a decrease in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.timeslive.co.za/news/south-africa/2021-02-28-sa-moves-to-covid-19-alert-level-1/ (''Timeslive'')]
***South Africa signs an agreement with [[Johnson & Johnson]] to secure 11 million doses of their [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-safrica-idUSKCN2AS0NQ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[Centers for Disease Control]]'s Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices recommends Johnson & Johnson's single-shot vaccine for people over the age of 18, a day after the [[Food and Drug Administration]] approved the emergency use of the vaccine. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/covid-vaccine-johnson-and-johnson-authorized-emergency-use/ (CBS News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**[[Hong Kong Police Force|Police]] [[criminal charge|charge]] 47 out of the 55 arrested last month during a mass raid with "subversion". Those charged include Professor [[Benny Tai]], former legislator [[James To]], activist and district councilor [[Lester Shum]] and [[League of Social Democrats]] politicians and activists [[Leung Kwok-hung]] and [[Jimmy Sham]], who was particularly defiant in court. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-56228363 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020–2021 Thai protests]]
**Sixteen protesters are wounded after [[Royal Thai Police|police]] use [[tear gas]], [[water cannon]] and [[rubber bullet]]s on pro-democracy protesters near the residence of [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Prayut Chan-o-cha]] in [[Bangkok]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/28/thai-police-protesters (Al Jazeera)]
*Police in [[Kazakhstan]] arrest 50 protesters who were calling for the release of [[political prisoner]]s in line with a resolution passed by the [[European Parliament]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/2/28/dozens-detained-at-kazakhstan-political-prisoner-protest (Al Jazeera)]
